acceptance_criteria: AC-1: Page accessible from admin exam list via View Analytics button/link
AC-2: Score distribution histogram with recharts BarChart, 10 fixed buckets
AC-3: Pass rate visualisation with recharts PieChart/RadialBarChart
AC-4: Statistics row: avg score, median score, total attempts, unique participants
AC-5: Table sortable by correct_rate (default ascending) and avg_time_seconds
AC-6: correct_rate < 0.40 → red left border + Consider Revising tooltip
AC-7: correct_rate > 0.95 → amber/yellow left border + Consider Removing tooltip
AC-8: Export CSV button calls GET /admin/exams/:id/results/export
AC-9: useQuery with queryKey ['exam-analytics', examId]; loading skeletons
AC-10: Zero hardcoded strings; all use useTranslation i18n keys
